property_summary: After calling adjustAdminAccess(address,bool) to set an address as admin, the reference contract allows that admin to call createGameItem (which checks isAdmin[msg.sender]), while the buggy contract reverts the balanceOf call inside createGameItem due to the injected require(false) in balanceOf (called internally via _mint which calls _doSafeTransferAcceptanceCheck which calls to.isContract() which calls the target's balanceOf, hitting the bug).
change_summary: Replace require check with always false condition to always revert
